name: privesc_linux
description: Linux privilege escalation enumeration: SUID, cron, capabilities, writable paths, kernel, sudo checks.
author: james-linux

params.command: echo '=== SYSTEM ===' && uname -a && cat /etc/*release 2>/dev/null | head -5 && echo '' && echo '=== KERNEL ===' && uname -r
echo '=== USERS ===' && cat /etc/passwd | grep -v nologin | grep -v false && echo '' && echo '=== SUDO ===' && sudo -l 2>/dev/null | tail -10
echo '=== SUID BINARIES ===' && find / -perm -4000 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -30
echo '=== CRON JOBS ===' && cat /etc/crontab 2>/dev/null && ls -la /etc/cron* 2>/dev/null && echo '' && echo '=== WRITABLE CRON ===' && find /etc/cron* -writable -type f 2>/dev/null

steps.description: Cron job enumeration and writable cron files

params.command: echo '=== WRITABLE /etc ===' && find /etc -writable -type f 2>/dev/null | head -15 && echo '' && echo '=== WRITABLE PATH DIRS ===' && echo $PATH | tr ':' '\n' | while read d; do [ -w "$d" ] && echo "WRITABLE: $d"; done

steps.description: Find writable sensitive files and PATH directories

params.command: echo '=== LISTENING PORTS ===' && ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | head -20 && echo '' && echo '=== INTERFACES ===' && ip a | grep -E 'inet |link/' | head -15

echo '=== INTERESTING FILES ===' && find / -name '*.bak' -o -name '*.old' -o -name '*.conf' -o -name '.bash_history' -o -name '.ssh' -o -name 'id_rsa' 2>/dev/null | head -20 && echo '' && echo '=== DOCKER ===' && id | grep -i docker && ls -la /var/run/docker.sock 2>/dev/null

steps.description: Find backup files, SSH keys, Docker socket access
